spans: This Promotion and Distribution Agreement including all exhibits (collectively referred to as the "Agreement"), effective as of 1 August 2011 (the  "Effective Date"), is made by and between Whitesmoke Inc.

11.3 Assignment. [ * ] may [ * ]any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of [ * ]. For the  avoidance of doubt, a Change of Control shall be deemed an assignment hereunder unless [ * ] does not exercise its [ * ].

(d) Records and Audit Rights. Distributor will keep and maintain complete and accurate books, records, and accounts relating to  this Agreement. During the Term, and for a period of [ * ] thereafter, Google may audit Distributor's relevant records to confirm  Distributor's compliance with this Agreement. Google's auditor will only have access to those books and records of Distributor  which are reasonably necessary to confirm such compliance.

"Term" means the earlier of: (a) the end of the two year period from the Effective Date to 31 July 2013; or (b) the last day of the calendar month  within which the Maximum Distribution Commitment is reached.

11.10 Governing Law. This Agreement is governed by English law and the parties submit to the exclusive jurisdiction of the English courts in  relation to any dispute (contractual or non-contractual) concerning this Agreement

This Promotion and Distribution Agreement including all exhibits (collectively referred to as the "Agreement"), effective as of 1 August 2011 (the  "Effective Date"), is made by and between Whitesmoke Inc., with registered offices/principle place of business at 501 Silverside Road, Suite 105,  Wilmington DE 19809, USA, ("Distributor"), and Google Inc whose principle place of business is at 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View,  CA 94043, USA ("Google").

notes: Expiration Date takes the fixed calendar date given for the two-year branch of the 'earlier of' Term definition (31 July 2013); the alternative branch (reaching the redacted Maximum Distribution Commitment) could end the Term sooner but is not calculable from the text, so the true expiration may be earlier than the date given. Governing Law answer 'England' is taken from the clause's own wording ('English law', 'English courts'); the contract does not use the phrase 'England and Wales'. Non-Compete is called No: Clause 3.5 is titled 'Exclusivity' and its content is redacted, and per the operational rule exclusivity/exclusive-dealing commitments are not Non-Compete. IP Ownership Assignment is called No: Clauses 7.1-7.2 have each party retain ownership of its own pre-existing IP (Products/Trademarks for Google, Distributor Apps for Distributor) rather than assigning newly created IP to the counterparty.
